steps.name: sync-exact-head
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; git fetch origin main; test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "c6bf72310289c88b9644723ce8635c5288cad6f6"; git checkout -B main origin/main; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "c6bf72310289c88b9644723ce8635c5288cad6f6"

steps.name: require-direct-usb-and-idle
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; adb start-server >/dev/null; adb devices -l; LINE="$(adb devices -l | awk -v s="$SERIAL" '$1==s && $2=="device" {print}')"; test -n "$LINE" || { echo 'direct_usb_s22=false' >&2; exit 2; }; MODEL="$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r')"; test "$MODEL" = SM-S906B; STATE="$(python3 - <<'PY'
from scripts.aicall_tools.device.s22_call_control import Adb
print(Adb('RFCT70L7E8J').call_state())
PY
)"; test "$STATE" = 0 || { echo "call_state_not_idle=$STATE" >&2; exit 3; }; echo 'direct_usb_s22=true'; echo 'call_state_idle=true'
